title: kengyilia melanthera
intro: Kengyilia melanthera, commonly known as Chinese needle grass, is a type of plant species in the family Poaceae. Chinese needle grass is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to lower blood sugar levels and cholesterol, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Kengyilia melanthera include its anti-diabetic and anti-hyperlipidemic properties, making it a potential natural remedy for managing diabetes and high cholesterol. The bioactive constituents of Kengyilia melanthera include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
